answer: The whisper register is checked at draw time, reef lists the eligible set, and orchard seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 37 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 37 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. A farm of 96 pays that 52 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
